## Owner-lock, fidelity, and deletion audit

- [ ] Every exact owner lock remains present and every protected rhetorical function was reviewed article-wide.
- [ ] Every unique claim, step, joke, example, transition, argument, and owner realization is preserved or explicitly dispositioned.
- [ ] Every cut, condensation, relocation, or replacement lists original text, destination/semantic equivalent, and owner approval where required.
- [ ] Rejected cuts and unincorporated ideas remain recoverable; no apparently redundant material was silently discarded.
- [ ] No argument, agency, severity, chronology, or uncertainty was silently softened, balanced, or changed.
